items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1962-03-22
items.q: Joe Pascal, he's a slater, a roofer.

ctx.x: I heard that name. I heard that name. I heard that name.
I heard that name about this about, or not about a mother. Joe Pascal, he's a slater, a roofer.
Do you remember the Spanish and American War? Yeah. Well, I remember the Civil War, too. What went on there? Shooting and gun on.
